final.passage: The Meilisearch rankingScoreThreshold is a tuning parameter, not a calibrated relevance guarantee. critic.passage: ### M2 — Distinguish Local Contexts Notice type and conditions

final.passage: If Local Contexts applies, do not recommend an unspecified Notice generically. The FAQ distinguishes Disclosure and Engagement Notices, which may be used without community approval, from Collections Care Notices, which are to be used only after engagement with Indigenous community authorities. Labels are community-controlled and customizable; an institution should not author or alter one. A Notice is not a substitute for a community Label. The institution must identify the applicable Notice type and follow its conditions; communities decide whether and when to apply Labels. The Hub distributes Labels and Notices; it is not the museum’s content repository. Any API/static snapshot choice has account, project-visibility, and freshness conditions. See [Local Contexts FAQ](https://localcontexts.org/support/frequently-asked-questions/) and [V02](sources/01-reviser-verifications.md#v02).

criticism_dispositions.reasoning: FAQ expressly distinguishes Disclosure/Engagement from Collections Care. Final retains community engagement conditions and institutional/community role boundaries.

critic.passage: ### M3 — Keep embedding disclosure/inference claims framed as hypotheses

final.passage: The draft’s concern that restricted text could influence retrieval or disclose membership is a **threat hypothesis**, not a demonstrated Meilisearch leak. Open issue #6591 reports a version- and configuration-specific hybrid ranking-score change after adding a null searchable field; it does not report extraction of restricted text and was not reproduced here. Before any adoption, use restricted/public fixtures to test whether schema changes or embedding inputs alter ranking, snippets, membership inference, or other selected visibility outcomes. Review provider data-flow and terms separately. If those conditions are not acceptable, retain keyword-only search or assess local/self-hosted embeddings.

final.passage: Retain curator-authored searches as one slice, but include visitors who do not know museum vocabulary.
